name: le.ad
description: An empty hot desk: six desks, one claim at a time, and a ninety-second lease that returns them.

pitches.reader: An empty desk you can take, a lamp that shows the lease, and a link that hands the desk to someone else.
pitches.packager: The desk-claim isotope: a lease on a connection point, specified, executed, and proposed upstream.
pitches.maintainer: A seed whose content is a protocol, with three artefacts that have to agree or the build refuses.
